name: Exotic Weapons Shop
desc1: This large, astonishingly clean shop is filled with a dizzying array
desc2: of all manner of exotic weapons, many of which are not seen in this
desc3: part of the world. They cover countertops and hang from racks, all
desc4: displayed proudly and well-polished. In the corner you can see an
desc5: expansive private gym, complete with a great variety of iron weights.
desc6: The only exit is through the entrance to the north.
